title: DJIA Market Happenings For Friday, September 14, 2018
text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Friday, September 14, 2018 Posted by admin on September 14th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include American Express (AXP), Merck (MRK), Microsoft (MSFT), Nike (NKE), Pfizer (PFE) and Visa (V). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +21 points.
Thursday the Dow was up +147.07 (+0.57%) at 26,145.99.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +5.77%.
There were 23 Dow stocks up Thursday.
The Dow stock winners Thursday were led by Apple (AAPL) +2.42% and IBM (IBM) +1.62%.
The Dow stock losers Thursday were led by McDonald’s (MCD) -1.42% and Home Depot (HD) -1.19%.
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended mostly higher.
The national average price of gasoline is up eight-tenths of a cent at $2.852 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
Nike (NKE) reports earnings on 9/25/2018 after the market close.
Today’s Featured Dow Stock
Cisco (CSCO)
Cisco (CSCO) is up +23.34% year-to-date.
